title: imap: essential extensions (IDLE, UIDPLUS, CONDSTORE, QRESYNC, LITERAL+, SPECIAL-USE, MOVE)
description:
Implement the seven extensions that modern MUAs depend on for correct and efficient operation. Without these, clients break or perform unacceptably.

- IDLE (RFC 2177): server push for new mail; without it clients must poll.
- UIDPLUS (RFC 4315): APPENDUID/COPYUID response codes so clients can track messages across APPEND and COPY without re-scanning.
- CONDSTORE (RFC 4551): HIGHESTMODSEQ lets clients fetch only changed flags since last sync; essential for large mailboxes.
- QRESYNC (RFC 7162): quick resync after disconnect using saved HIGHESTMODSEQ and UID validity; critical for mobile clients.
- LITERAL+ (RFC 7888): non-synchronising literals; eliminates extra round-trip on APPEND of large messages.
- SPECIAL-USE (RFC 6154): LIST \Inbox \Sent \Trash \Drafts \Junk role flags; without it clients guess folder names and break.
- MOVE (RFC 6851): atomic mailbox move command; without it clients do COPY + STORE \Deleted + EXPUNGE which is non-atomic.

Note: CONDSTORE and QRESYNC are activated via ENABLE (tracked in the interop extensions issue). Implement ENABLE first.
